description: This is a Java unit test class for ImmutableJsonArray, testing immutability, equality, hash code, array operations, and internal caching strategies.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonArrayTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the ImmutableJsonArray class, covering various aspects such as creation, equality, immutability, array content, index operations, and internal cache handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableJsonArray and its internal list are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Tests the correctness of hashCode and equals implementations for ImmutableJsonArray.

methods.name: toList
methods.description: Helper method converting varargs to a List of JsonValue.

methods.name: twoParsedArraysFromSameStringHaveSameHashCode
methods.description: Ensures that parsing the same JSON array string produces objects with equal hash codes.

methods.name: emptyArrayIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks that an empty ImmutableJsonArray reports size zero and emptiness.

methods.name: getSizeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getSize returns the correct number of elements.

methods.name: asArrayReturnsSameObjectReference
methods.description: Ensures that asArray returns the same reference and not a copy.

methods.name: arrayIsNothingElse
methods.description: Confirms that an array is not mistaken for other JSON types and is not boolean, number, or string.

methods.name: checkUnsupportedOperations
methods.description: Verifies that unsupported JSON conversions throw exceptions.

methods.name: containsWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Checks that contains correctly identifies contained JsonValues.

methods.name: tryToAddIntFurtherLongValues
methods.description: Tests that adding null integers throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: addIntReturnsDisjointArray
methods.description: Verifies that adding integers produces a new array without modifying the original.

methods.name: tryToAddNullFurtherLongValues
methods.description: Tests that adding null longs throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: addLongReturnsDisjointArray
methods.description: Verifies that adding longs produces a new disjoint array.

methods.name: tryToAddNullFurtherDoubleValues
methods.description: Checks that adding null doubles throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: addDoubleReturnsDisjointArray
methods.description: Verifies that adding doubles returns a new array.

methods.name: tryToAddNullFurtherBooleanValues
methods.description: Ensures adding null booleans throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: addBooleanReturnsDisjointArray
methods.description: Tests adding boolean values creates a new array.

methods.name: tryToAddNullStringValue
methods.description: Tests that adding null string throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToAddNullFurtherStringValues
methods.description: Checks that adding null string values throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: addStringReturnsDisjointArray
methods.description: Verifies that adding strings produces a new array.

methods.name: tryToAddNullJsonValue
methods.description: Tests that adding null JsonValue throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToAddNullFurtherJsonValues
methods.description: Checks that adding null JsonValues throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: addJsonValueReturnsDisjointArray
methods.description: Verifies that adding JsonValues produces a new array.

methods.name: indexOfReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that indexOf finds the correct position of a value.

methods.name: iteratorWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that iterator over the array yields elements in order and counts correctly.

methods.name: toStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the toString method outputs a JSON array string representation.

methods.name: getValueAtInvalidIndex
methods.description: Ensures get returns empty Optional for invalid index.

methods.name: getValueAtValidIndex
methods.description: Checks get returns the correct element for a valid index.

methods.name: validateSoftReferenceStrategy
methods.description: Ensures internal soft reference caches in ImmutableJsonArray are functioning as expected.

methods.name: assertInternalCachesAreAsExpected
methods.description: Helper to inspect internal cache fields via reflection.
